_comment: Machine-readable layer index for Truvio.Commerce.Distribution (P3, RUN-VERSION-CURRENCY T3-01..T3-04). SOURCE OF TRUTH for what layers exist, their kind/version/status, and what a retired name was superseded by. Two consumers read it: (1) tools/ci/Validate-Distribution.ps1 regenerates the `layers` array from the live tree and diffs it clean (drift both directions FAILs), asserts `gateProven` is present, and rejects any edition ref or living-doc mention of a name absent from `layers` (a retired hit names its successor); (2) the DemoAgent currency preflight (Invoke-DemoGate.ps1 `currency` leg) asserts this file parses + carries `gateProven`, and that every layer the demo consumed is live here (a retired hit -> 'retired -> use <supersededBy>'). UPDATE MECHANICS: the `layers` array is regenerated from the tree by Validate-Distribution.ps1 -RegenerateIndex (deterministic); `retired` tombstones are authored on layer retirement (release checklist, FOLLOWUP.md T4-02); `gateProven` is stamped by the FOUNDRY publish flow at release time (tools/harness/Write-IndexGateProven.ps1) from the gate run(s) that proved this main -- never hand-authored as trusted. Consumers 'pin origin/main + assert INDEX.gateProven present' (D-CONSUME a). EDITIONS APPEAR IN gateProven.editions ONLY WHEN PROVEN: the map is a record of gate runs, stamped by Write-IndexGateProven.ps1, so a newly specified edition (base-swift, added in the v5 phase-2 baseline release) is absent from it until its first PASS. An absent edition means unproven, never missing; hand-writing a run id there would fabricate an attestation, which is the one thing this file exists to prevent.
